title: Google Cloud TPU Inference Serving: vLLM-TPU vs. JetStream, Pallas Ragged PagedAttention & ICI P/D Disaggregation Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Unbucketed HuggingFace/PyTorch-XLA Serving + Contiguous Static KV Cache
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Runtime XLA recompilations & 68% contiguous KV fragmentation ($1.65/1M tokens)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Bucketed JetStream + MaxEngine (Co-Located Prefill/Decode, No Prefix Cache)
tiers.verdict: Great for native MaxText RL rollouts, but 8K Prefills spike co-located Decode P99 TPOT to 42ms

tiers.name: Tier 3: Co-Located vLLM-TPU V1 (Pallas PagedAttention + Chunked Prefill, Single Pool)
tiers.verdict: Solid general serving, but bursty 32K prompts still contend with Decode on shared MXUs

tiers.name: Tier 4: vLLM-TPU V1 + Persistent XLA Cache + Pallas Ragged PagedAttention + ICI P/D Disaggregation
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 14.8ms P99 TPOT, 79.4% Decode MBU, $0.21/1M tokens & -73.3% TCO ($112K/mo)
